newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open barely changed Thursday, floor sources said.
A move below support pegged at Wednesday's low of 11.55 cents a lb could trigger sell stops and pressure the spot month to its next downside target of 11.45 cents, traders said.
Wednesday, the benchmark October contract closed down 0.08 cent at 11.58 cents after trading from 11.68 to 11.55 cents. The back months settled 0.03 to 0.11 cent weaker.
An estimated 14,924 lots changed hands on the day.

London white sugar futures were mixed in subdued trading at midday Thursday, with the nearby contracts recovering from early lows. At 0844 EDT/1244 GMT, LIFFE October stood 20 cents higher at $327.90, after ranging from $328.00 to $324.90.
